And so I think we need to think about what's happening in college and university right now, because one of the reasons that we're trying to create a mass higher education experience is because in the same way that a hundred years ago there wasn't a use for all fifteen-year-olds in the economy. Today there's not really a use for lots of nineteen and twenty-year-olds in the economy and so one of the main reasons we're trying to create a mass college experience is basically just as a way to warehouse kids who are now five and six and seven years beyond puberty and we don't have a lot of uses for them. And so they're being warehoused in college but they're not always that productive there. So I think parents should wrestle to the ground. What are you trying to accomplish for your kids and help your kids learn how to accomplish for themselves at 14 at 16 at 18 at 20? And many times college will be the right tool that you should know what goal you have in mind and then figure out if the tool meets the goal, not assume that the tool is the normative thing.
